_comment: Tier-scale definitions and the normalization map. Each source declares which scale it uses (sources.json → scale). Values place every tier on one 0–100 axis so sources with different scales can be averaged into a consensus. Consensus bands must be sorted by descending min, ending at 0. 2026-08-14 (owner decision, Riley — applied ahead of the 08-18 flip rather than in the flip commit): the LIVE icyveins scale is now the SAME seven bands as icyveins-ptr. Icy Veins rebuilt its live M+ lists for Midnight Season 2 and they publish S+ and B+, which the old five-band scale could not represent — the merge had been blocked for six days because storing an S+ letter would have failed validation and collapsing it into S was refused as fabrication. The two scales are now identical by intent, not coincidence, so the note below about them deliberately diverging is HISTORY: it described the window when only the PTR list had the extra rungs. Measured on landing: re-spacing S from 100 to 92 re-scores the frozen Season-1 letters the consensus still reads through the frozen lane, moving 13 consensus scores and 3 M+ letters (Unholy DK, Devourer DH, Augmentation Evoker, all S -> A+) — a scale decision, not spec movement, which is why CONSENSUS_VERSION went 3 -> 4 in the same commit. Its shared tiers keep the live anchors exactly (A+ 82 / A 66 / B 48 / C 30) so the same author's live and PTR reads are directly comparable on the axis; B+ sits at 57, the midpoint of A and B. 2026-08-04 (owner decision, Riley): the PTR DPS list added a SEVENTH band, S+, in its 02 Aug. "Update #4" — S+ takes the 100 anchor and S shifts down to 92. This is the one place the PTR scale deliberately stops matching the live one: PTR S is 92 while live S is 100, because the PTR list now reserves a rung above S that the live list has no equivalent for. Collapsing S+ into S was rejected — it would fabricate a placement the source is explicitly distinguishing. Note this re-spacing moves every icyveins-ptr-derived projection input, not just the two S+ specs, since the source feeds projectionFor via ptrTierRead at weight .25 (it is era:ptr, so consensus is untouched).
